scope: Finite rational frequency families, complete integer horizons, fixed start N=1. Independent research on the prepublished continuation.

definitions.normalized_nonzero_angle: V_t(N)=1-exp(i N t), h_t=C_t V_t, C_t=exp(it)/(1-exp(it))
definitions.constant_channel: N -> 1. Assign the shared constant exactly once when combining fields.
definitions.zero_angle: h_0(N)=N has divergent infinite squared norm. V_0=V_{2pi}=0 in the interpolation model.

exact.real_bridge_residual: pi(min(x,y)-u)(v-max(x,y))/(v-u) inside the same retained cell [u,v], zero across cells
exact.phase_witness: The squared norms of V_(pi/2)+i V_pi and V_(pi/2)-i V_pi differ in absolute value by 8 Catalan.

bounds.mesh: For complex amplitudes, residual squared norm <= twice the real bridge residual Gram form. For real normalized amplitudes equality holds with factor one.
bounds.tail: For distinct rational frequencies in turns with spacing delta and a merged coefficient vector b, absolute error from s_M sum |b|^2 is <= 3 sum |b|^2/(delta (M+1)^2); a singleton gives zero error.
bounds.coherent_tail: For |t|<=pi, |sum_{n>M} exp(i n t)/n^2 - Psi(Mt)/M| <= pi/M^2, Psi(v)=integral_{1}^infinity exp(i v x)/x^2 dx.
bounds.future_port: Use Cauchy-Schwarz with the residual norm for all future bounded linear tests. For the frequency tail matrix use the operator norm bound in road.md.
bounds.arithmetic_pair: For fixed squarefree m and primes p<q coprime to m, distance squared of complete A_mp and A_mq blocks is phi(m)*(q-p)*log^+(p/(q-p))+O_m(q-p).

provenance_and_limits.baseline: The dilogarithm formula, diagonal, previous cutoff and fixed-Q tail are already in the wave-15 anchored coherence note.
provenance_and_limits.observer: T8 spectrum, T6 operation-safe quotient and the pre-existing spectral tail coupling interface, applied to complex phases.
provenance_and_limits.unresolved: A uniform RH-scale estimate after summing the entire arithmetic frequency family as road thickness tends to zero.
